features.name: See today’s orders
features.does: Lists every order the stall has taken today, what each one costs, and how many there are.

features.name: Take an order
features.does: Writes down a new order and shows what it will cost before it is saved.

features.name: Count the day’s takings
features.does: Adds up everything the stall took today and the GST owed on it.
